articles.title: FCA fines major UK bank £12.4M for AML failures
articles.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority imposed a significant penalty on a major UK retail bank for inadequate anti-money laundering controls that persisted between 2019 and 2023.

articles.title: AMF sanctions investment firm for client communication breaches
articles.summary: French regulator penalized an asset management firm for failing to provide clear and accurate information to clients regarding investment risks.

articles.title: BaFin issues public warning against unauthorized payment provider
articles.summary: German financial regulator published a consumer warning about a payment services provider operating without proper licensing.
